title: 2-Day Mikumi Safari from Dar es Salaam
basis: 4 adults; two sharing each room
start: Dar es Salaam → Dar es Salaam
style: Private road safari · one lodge night
summary: A short road safari with an overnight near Mikumi, an afternoon game drive and another wildlife morning before returning to Dar es Salaam.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Dar es Salaam to Mikumi
itinerary.text: Start early from the agreed pickup point. Road traffic affects the journey. Reach the Mikumi area, take lunch and join a game drive within the confirmed park-access period. Stay at the named lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: A wildlife morning, then back to Dar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore suitable park tracks with your driver-guide. Break for the included lunch and begin the road return in good time. Confirm the actual driving plan before booking onward travel.

includes: Private safari vehicle and English-speaking driver-guide for the listed road route
1 lodge night, two adults sharing
Meals from lunch on day 1 through lunch on day 2; drinking water
Listed game drives and applicable park, vehicle and conservation charges
excludes: International flights, visas and travel insurance
Unlisted meals, drinks, personal purchases and tips
Hotels and transfers before or after the listed itinerary
Flights, optional village visit and walking safari
notes: USD 475 is based on four adults travelling together. Day 1 is partly a transfer day. Park access is priced for the stated itinerary; extra access periods cost more. Avoid a tight evening flight on day 2. Share your hotel so departure and return points are agreed.

title: 6-Day Northern Safari & Local Culture
basis: 4 adults; two sharing each room
summary: Connect Tarangire, Lake Manyara, the Serengeti and Ngorongoro with a hosted cultural visit. Five nights allow time for the road journeys and a full day on the plains.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Tarangire and the Karatu highlands
itinerary.text: Begin in Arusha, explore Tarangire and continue to the named highland lodge for your first night.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Lake Manyara and a hosted local visit
itinerary.text: Choose a Lake Manyara game drive with the agreed timing, followed by a pre-arranged host-led visit near the highlands. The host, activity, language and community fee are confirmed; this is not an uninvited village stop.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Travel to the Serengeti
itinerary.text: Drive the permitted highland transit route, with lunch and a game drive as time allows. Stay at the named Serengeti camp.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: A full day on the plains
itinerary.text: Give the Serengeti a full wildlife day with a picnic or agreed camp lunch. Seasonal routing follows the actual accommodation and road plan, not a promise of a migration crossing.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Towards the crater highlands
itinerary.text: Enjoy a morning game drive, then travel back towards the Ngorongoro highlands. Stay near the crater route so the next morning can begin without a long Serengeti drive.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Crater descent and return to Arusha
itinerary.text: Descend into Ngorongoro at the confirmed access time, explore with a picnic and return to Arusha. A late arrival is possible; discuss an extra hotel night before your flight.

includes: Private safari vehicle, driver-guide and listed game drives
5 named camp/lodge nights, two adults sharing
Meals from lunch on day 1 through lunch on day 6; drinking water
Applicable park, crater, vehicle, transit and concession charges
One pre-arranged host-led cultural activity with the agreed community fee
excludes: International flights, visas and travel insurance
Unlisted meals, drinks, personal purchases and tips
Hotels and transfers before or after the listed itinerary
notes: A tailored quote is used because accommodation, cultural hosts, permits and dates materially affect cost. The cultural visit respects consent, photography preferences and local payment arrangements. School visits, staged ceremonies and donations are not automatic inclusions.

title: 4-Day Private Luxury Northern Safari
basis: 2 adults; two sharing each room
summary: A compact luxury itinerary through Tarangire, Lake Manyara and Ngorongoro, with three lodge nights and a vehicle reserved for your own party.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Tarangire, with a private vehicle
itinerary.text: Depart Arusha for a focused Tarangire game drive. Continue to the named lodge, selected for your dates and preferred comfort.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Lake Manyara and a slower afternoon
itinerary.text: Explore Lake Manyara with your guide and return to the agreed highland lodge. Keep some afternoon time to enjoy the property rather than adding another long transfer.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.text: Use the agreed crater-access time for a game drive and picnic. Return to the named lodge; timings follow the actual park arrangements.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Breakfast and return to Arusha
itinerary.text: Enjoy breakfast and make the agreed return transfer to Arusha. Airport departure timing or a final lunch is quoted around your actual plans.

includes: Private safari 4×4 and English-speaking driver-guide
3 nights in named luxury lodges, two adults sharing
Meals and drinks only as itemised for each property in the written quote
Listed park, crater, concession, vehicle and activity charges
Drinking water during game drives and the agreed return transfer
excludes: International flights, visas and travel insurance
Unlisted meals, drinks, personal purchases and tips
Hotels and transfers before or after the listed itinerary
Serengeti extension, premium drinks and private charter flights
notes: This itinerary keeps the four days within the Tarangire–Manyara–Ngorongoro region. The Serengeti needs a longer route or a separately priced fly-in plan. Luxury is defined by named properties and room categories in your quote; photos do not promise a particular lodge or vehicle.
